title: Fermix accessory link control messages
description: The JSON control messages of the Fermix accessory link (frame type 1), by sender. Source of truth: FermixCore.Accessories.Control. PROTOCOL.md holds the framing, the transcripts and the rules a schema cannot state: a message with a stream field travels on that frame stream and every other on stream 0, a receiver ignores fields it does not know, keys never repeat, and a message is at most 8,192 bytes and nested at most 8 containers deep (the message object is the first).

accessory.calibrate.description: axis and a non-zero steps exactly when op is nudge.

call.result.description: A refused request names its code.

diag.counters.description: The latest microphone opening's six levels come all together or not at all.

hello.description: wire_min is at most wire_max (PROTOCOL.md, Versioning).

hello_ack.description: An enrolled accessory signs; an unenrolled one sends accessory_id and sig both null.

refuse.description: A wire_version refusal names the sender's own wire range.
